bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, footer, secondary button fills — warm off-white replaces cold digital white, giving every screen a paper-like base

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated panels, input fields — the bright layer above bone

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, dark filled buttons, heading color — the default ink, warm near-black rather than #000

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Hairline borders, icon strokes, the announcement bar — the thinnest line work

fossil.$description: Fossil — Secondary text, muted borders, body annotations

pebble.$description: Pebble — Input field borders, disabled controls

sand.$description: Sand — Active tab background, subtle surface lift, button hover on bone

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline dividers, footer borders, low-contrast separators

chartreuse.$description: Chartreuse — Highlight badges, study tags, the globe motif, card accent fills — the only chromatic note in the system, used sparingly to draw the eye to research signals

olive.$description: Olive — Decorative border accent, chromatic link underline — the only deep color, appears in the olive outline treatments and the heading underline on the hero

ui-sans-serif.$description: ui-sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

phonic.$description: Display, headings, body — the brand's signature humanist serif set aggressively tight at large sizes (–0.09em at 130px down to +0.03em at 12px). Weight 300 dominates for display, 400 for body. The custom typeface carries the editorial voice; weight 300 at 130px is the signature move — most brands use 600–700 here, Maze whispers in a light serif to claim authority through restraint.

system-ui-sans.$description: Secondary UI text, fallback for browser contexts — only used sparingly; Phonic carries the brand
